sql: SELECT ProductName, UnitPrice, UnitCost, round((UnitPrice - UnitCost) * 100.0 / nullIf(UnitPrice, 0), 2) as margin_pct FROM retail.DimProduct WHERE UnitPrice > 0 ORDER BY margin_pct DESC LIMIT 10
